sources.title: Timberwolves to retire Kevin Garnett’s No. 21 on February 28

claims.evidence: The team announced on Aug 14, 2026 that it will retire Garnett's No. 21 on Sunday, Feb 28, 2027, when it hosts Boston at Target Center in an NBC game. Reports differ on whether the ceremony comes before or after the game.
claims.action: Dated calendar[5] to Feb 28, 2027 and moved it to month 2. Updated topInsights[3], the big-ticket-heritage opportunity, the timing, risk and verify lines, the factcheck verdict and the dossier verify lists.

claims.claim: The 1989-90 Wolves drew about 1.07 million fans at the Metrodome, an NBA single-season attendance record
claims.evidence: The team's April 1990 release says the inaugural season drew 1,072,572 fans, an NBA regular-season record that beat Detroit's 1987-88 Silverdome mark. One stats site shows 1,027,572, which looks like a typo. Whether the record still stands was not checked.
claims.action: No change to research. factcheck.json verdict moved from unverifiable to confirmed.
